sources.title: bug(accounts): Team 30d quota is displayed as 5h
sources.body: ### Pre-flight checklist - [x] I searched existing issues for similar reports. - [x] I'm on the latest patch release of my minor version. ### codex-lb version 1.21.0 (`ghcr.io/soju06/codex-lb:1.21.0`) ### Affected account plan(s) Team ### Symptom category Dashboard display bug only ### What does the dashboard / logs show? ```markdown Team accounts with a 30-day quota window are rendered as `5h`. Example: `5h 96%`, reset `in 30d 9h`, while `Weekly` is `--`. Free accounts on the same dashboard correctly show `Monthly`. ``` ### What did you expect? The label should follow the observed window duration (`43200` minutes → `Monthly`/`30d`). Monthly-only paid accounts should not render synthetic `5h` or `Weekly` rows. ### Last observed quota reset time (UTC) _Not applicable — dashboard display bug only._ ### When did it start? Observed on 2026-07-16 while running 1.21.0. ### Additional context - Dashboard primary quota is hard-coded as `5h`: https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/blob/v1.21.0/frontend/src/features/dashboard/components/account-list.tsx#L62-L85 - Monthly capacity currently contains only `free`: https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/blob/v1.21.0/app/core/usage/__init__.py#L42-L48 - Monthly usage is dropped for plans without monthly capacity: https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/blob/v1.21.0/app/modules/accounts/mappers.py#L122-L123 Related #883 / #909 fixed the Free-plan case only.

sources.title: fix(accounts): preserve observed monthly quota across plans
sources.body:
## Summary

Team accounts with a lone 43800-minute quota appear as 5h, while exact 43200-minute quotas disappear because the plan has no monthly credit estimate. Normalize observed 28–32-day windows consistently in poll/live ingestion and retain their monthly percentages independently of credit capacity.

## Type of change

- [x] `fix:` — bug fix

Fixes #1367

## OpenSpec

- [x] This PR includes / updates an OpenSpec change

Change directory: `openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-10-fix-observed-monthly-quota/`. Main requirements are synced and the verified change is archived.

## Changes

- Accept absent or zero-duration secondary placeholders for monthly-only normalization; preserve real or unknown-duration secondary windows.
- Keep unknown monthly credits null. Newer 300/10080-minute samples still supersede stale monthly history after a plan upgrade.
- No new configuration, schema migration, dependencies or frontend implementation.

## Test plan

Reproduced on upstream `0f6a31c56ac30804ca1c0fac27ca02c6f59bf2b0` via GET `/api/accounts`: identical monthly observations gave 76% for Free and null for Team. Poll normalization was red in 7/8 accepted cases; live ingestion → accounts API was red in 3/4 duration/placeholder cases. Those cases are green after the fix.

Both database env vars used the same dedicated disposable SQLite database; main/background/fixture URLs were verified equal.

```text
uv run pytest tests/unit/test_usage.py tests/unit/test_usage_updater.py tests/unit/test_account_mappers.py tests/unit/test_live_usage_ingest.py tests/integration/test_accounts_api_extended.py tests/integration/test_live_usage_ingest.py -q
252 passed, 4 skipped

Additional reverse-transition API cases: 7 passed
uv run ruff check app tests: passed
uv run ty check: passed
OpenSpec 1.11.0 validate --specs --strict: 65 passed
Strict change validation: passed
Browser component assertions: 2 passed
```

Independent read-only review found no actionable correctness issue. Hosted CI and reviews remain pending; no deployment or live-account validation was performed.

## Screenshots / output

Unchanged AccountCard rendered with synthetic before/after quota payloads matching the reproduced monthly shape. These are isolated component captures, not production screenshots.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JustYannicc/codex-lb/2238c913bac2f56854fcc49e8677f1159a5fa662/openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-10-fix-observed-monthly-quota/evidence/before.png) | ![After](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JustYannicc/codex-lb/2238c913bac2f56854fcc49e8677f1159a5fa662/openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-10-fix-observed-monthly-quota/evidence/after.png) |

## Checklist

- [x] Conventional Commits title and linked issue.
- [x] Regression tests cover the public account-summary path.
- [x] Relevant backend check subset completed.
- [x] Strict OpenSpec validation and implementation verification completed.
- [x] P1–P6 reviewed; no settings or navigation budget changes.
- [x] CHANGELOG untouched.

sources.title: fix(accounts): preserve quota chart samples and account display state
sources.body:
Switching from a Plus account to a monthly-only Free account can retain the previous account's 5-hour/weekly percentages and hide the selected account's monthly quota. Reset the smoothed display state by account ID. Show only existing trend series in the legend and label monthly tooltips consistently.

The trend chart also used one series' timestamps and replaced missing values in the other series with zero. Preserve the union of timestamps and interpolate missing samples between observations using elapsed time, holding the last known value after the final sample and leaving values unknown before the first sample, so actual observations are not discarded or shown as exhaustion.

This is an independent frontend fix based on upstream `3d23d53f8`; it contains no usage-limit feature changes from #1528. #2321 concerns backend monthly-window normalization and does not cover these frontend defects. No API, routing, database, settings, or navigation changes.

## Validation

- 153 account frontend tests passed, including regression tests for account switching and non-aligned series.
- TypeScript, ESLint for changed files, and production frontend build passed.
- Strict OpenSpec validation passed: `fix-account-trend-missing-samples`.
- Built-in browser: reproduced the account-switch defect with unmodified upstream components and verified the fix using synthetic local data. No production accounts or services were accessed.
- Interpolation follow-up: 6 focused chart tests (including unequal time intervals, actual zero, and a newly arriving sample), TypeScript, changed-file ESLint, and strict OpenSpec validation passed; updated built-in browser evidence below.
- Hosted CI and maintainer review are pending.

## Account switching: before / after

After selecting Monthly Free following Plus, the old panel incorrectly retains **5h 82% / Weekly 67%** from Plus. The fixed panel shows the selected Free account's **Monthly 85%**. These captures use the same local synthetic data:

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Stale Plus quota values on the selected Free account](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NikitaMGrimm/codex-lb/525b703ea9253e2b723e7e38aca9637689ef6e7b/openspec/changes/fix-account-trend-missing-samples/evidence/before.png) | ![Only the selected account's 85 percent monthly quota](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NikitaMGrimm/codex-lb/525b703ea9253e2b723e7e38aca9637689ef6e7b/openspec/changes/fix-account-trend-missing-samples/evidence/after.png) |

## Missing chart samples: before / after

These screenshots use the actual chart components with identical synthetic inputs. The blue 5-hour series ends September 20. The green weekly series has **no observation on September 20**, then records **86% on September 21 and 85% on September 22**.

**Before:** the green line falsely falls to zero on September 20. The chart ends there, discarding both later weekly observations.

![Before: false zero and discarded later observations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NikitaMGrimm/codex-lb/40a46327584c4553e971ff4d0de997fa81d1b88d/openspec/changes/fix-account-trend-missing-samples/evidence/sparse-before.png)

**After:** September 20 interpolates to **88%**, between the observed 90% and 86%. Later weekly observations remain visible; the blue line holds its final observed **62%**. A newly arriving sample updates the preceding held segment through interpolation. Actual zero observations remain zero.

![After: continuous interpolation and retained final observations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NikitaMGrimm/codex-lb/40a46327584c4553e971ff4d0de997fa81d1b88d/openspec/changes/fix-account-trend-missing-samples/evidence/sparse-after.png)

Reproduction inputs are recorded in the change's `context.md`. These images demonstrate the synthetic regression; they do not establish the cause of any particular production history.

sources.title: fix(quota): validate planner timezones and tolerate legacy keys
sources.body:
## Summary

Saving a malformed planner timezone such as `/Europe/Stockholm` currently succeeds, then breaks forecast requests and cold-account routing with `ValueError`. Reject unknown or malformed non-empty timezone updates with HTTP 400 before saving any settings, and extend the existing UTC fallback to malformed keys already stored.

Valid timezone names are trimmed. Omitted, null, and blank timezone updates retain the existing value. Legacy keys remain stored for operator correction.

## OpenSpec

Requirements and operational context are synced to `openspec/specs/quota-phase-planner/`. The archived change is `openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-20-validate-quota-planner-timezones/` and records validation, atomic rejection, and legacy fallback behavior. No settings, dependencies, migrations, dashboard layout, or routing policy are added.

## Validation

- Integrated upstream `main` at `09a140fa9979a908e60acc97232367e0a08ef32c` without rewriting the existing branch. The former inherited migration blocker was fixed upstream by #2461.
- Full `uv run pre-commit run local-ci --hook-stage manual --all-files --verbose` passed on Linux/arm64 at `8566e1a09eda488507a7d346a6b04ceca4962c50`. This includes frontend lint/type/tests/build, Python lint/type/tests, Rust checks and dependency audit, SQLite/PostgreSQL migration checks, packaging, Docker build/scanning, Helm validation, and both kind smoke scenarios.
- The full run passed 1,643 frontend tests and 14,008 Python tests across the unit, integration, bridge, end-to-end, and PostgreSQL targets. Existing platform/database skips and the existing expected failure were unchanged; no test was filtered or weakened for this refresh.
- Focused quota-planner suite: 56 passed. Before the fix, the focused regression selection produced 6 failures and 2 passes: invalid updates returned 200 and malformed legacy keys raised from forecast/routing.
- Live HTTP checks passed: malformed timezone updates return 400 atomically; valid timezone names are trimmed; null/blank updates retain the stored timezone; forecasts with a malformed legacy key return 200 using UTC while preserving the stored key.
- Scoped diagnostics and strict pinned OpenSpec 1.11.0 validation passed, including all 66 main specs. Prior independent local review found no actionable issues; the refresh adds the upstream merge and this verification record, with no further product-code or test changes.
- Native macOS execution exposed an unchanged capture-tool test assumption about `/tmp`; the complete successful gate ran against the unmodified commit in isolated Linux, matching GitHub CI's platform.

Current-head GitHub CI is tracked by the PR checks. The full local run used disposable databases and test infrastructure, which were removed after verification.

## API behavior

`PUT /api/quota-planner/settings` with `{"timezone":"/Europe/Stockholm","maxWarmupsPerDay":99}` returns HTTP 400 / `invalid_quota_planner` and leaves all settings unchanged. Forecasts using a legacy malformed key complete using UTC; cold-account routing matches the existing UTC behavior.
